body:
commit b000f55: wrapped net/tcp.prn+pty.prn+process.prn glue in runtime/parena_runtime.h in #ifndef _WIN32 (pty.h on Linux, util.h on macOS); replaced string.prn's contains-ci? glibc strcasestr call with a portable string_contains_ci_impl. Found and verified via a real x86_64-w64-mingw32-gcc cross-compile of the full editor-demo source (stub SDL2 headers). Zero regressions: 336 local unit tests, domain4 valgrind, domain5, sdl2/editor/render/io suites, editor-demo native -Werror build, bazel build+test all pass. Unblocks the pending cross-platform release-artifact work.

⚓ ☃
title: Windows-portable runtime.h + string.prn (real mingw-verified)
